searchText: > I think that's good... actually adding the word "testnet" to it wouldn't be appropriate since real value is at stake. I proposed the term "mainnet candidate" in the past to emphasize this is the real thing but could still be discarded in case it goes horribly wrong. "discarded"? What is meant by the word "discarded"? Can ETH2 be also discarded - after it is live in production for like 6 months (and everyone switched to it)?
